acceptance_met: Failing-first mock test proves the violation: 25 header-heavy records (~800B wire, 80B estimate) packed into one 18411B batch against a 2048 bound (9x over), failing on the claim SHA before the fix and passing after. No downgrade: the bound is violable.

Packing respects both limits for header-heavy (via batch_bytes and via max_request_size), keyed and empty-value records: take_count uses the header-aware record_size_upper_bound plus one RECORD_BATCH_OVERHEAD per partition group with a strict stop-before-crossing rule. Oversized single-record errors (reject_oversized), FIFO order, and rec_bytes buffer reservation accounting are untouched; the unsplittable-single exception (Java RecordAccumulator parity) is pinned by oversized_single_record_still_sends.

Informational bench_produce before/after on an isolated local broker (apache/kafka:3.9.1 KRaft, release builds, PAYLOAD_BYTES=100 ACKS=1 LINGER_MS=5 WARMUP_SECS=3 MEASURE_SECS=10, distinct 1-partition topics, interleaved B-A-B-A, pre-KL09-02 driver): BEFORE 824893 + 766806 rec/s, AFTER 991932 + 943257 rec/s (client try_send accepts; broker end offsets confirm full persistence, no silent drops). n=2, not statistically gated, no claim; plausible mechanism is ~35% fuller headerless batches (estimate 164B -> 121B). KL09-12 re-measures lb-bulk and nb-produce-headers.
commands: cargo test --locked --test mock_produce (5 passed, exit 0; 3 failed pre-fix with 18411B batch)
cargo test --locked --test produce_cancel -- --test-threads=2 (15 passed, exit 0; default parallelism flakes on loaded host, pre-existing)
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/conformance (44 passed, exit 0)
limits: batch_bytes bounds multi-record packing only; a single record under max_request_size still sends alone even if over batch_bytes (Java parity, pinned by test).
Request-level overhead (topic names, txn id) above the per-partition batch is not bounded; unchanged from Java.
Upper-bound (not exact) packing: varint-width slack of a few bytes per record plus exact group overhead.
Informational bench is n=2 interleaved on a loaded dev host with the pre-KL09-02 driver; not a gated claim.
